title: Quba Mere Diwane
visualBrief: Specific standing Quba Mere Diwane: octagonal pale stone temple body with dark stepped plinth, three closed wooden door bays, narrow recessed windows, engaged pilasters, simplified original sunburst/triangular relief bands, one tall central windowed drum/ribbed cone and seven smaller peripheral drums/cones with restrained gold spindle finials; mapped east side open square-post portico and short stairs. Nearby Ziarat temple, memorials, garden/cemetery and other buildings remain independent host context.
